documents.title: Proceeding Of 3Rd Annual General Meeting Held On 31 July 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Board Meeting Outcome for Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30,2026

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores for FY26, representing a 12% year-on-year growth driven primarily by its water business. In H2 FY26, consolidated revenue reached Rs. 188 crores while consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs. 29 crores.

guidance.claim: Management sees a positive sales growth outlook across all business units.
guidance.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

guidance.claim: Management foresees around 15 to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in quarter one.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: Management foresees volume growth in water chemicals to be roughly around 10%.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction chemicals volume grew by 30% in the second half to reach 2,590 metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of volume, first half we were at 1988 metric ton of volume. It increased by 30%. So in second half we were at 2590 metric tons of volume.

demand_outlook.claim: Distribution business volume nearly doubled in the second half to 1,049 metric tons compared to 594 metric tons in the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of volume for first half year, we were 594 metric ton and the volume nearly doubled to 1049 metric tons in second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Water business volume reached 4,813 metric tons in the second half, marking a 50% increase.
demand_outlook.quote: So Rs. 162 crores in second half year and volume growth from 9905 in terms of metric tons, it has grown to 4813 metric tons. So 50% increase in terms of volume for our water business and most of this is carrying forward.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the financial year increased to almost 20 to 21 crores, largely driven by the full-year impact of the demerger.
capex_expansion.quote: And I noticed that the CAPEX this year has shot up to almost 20, 21 crores or so.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹90.76 lakhs towards the installation of the 350 kVA rooftop solar plant during FY 2025-26.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹90.76 lakhs were invested towards installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at the Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for the second half reached Rs. 29 crores, representing a 31% improvement over the first half.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA for second year, second half at Rs.29 crores is a 31% improvement over the first half.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs began increasing from late February and March, with key metal-based raw materials like zinc and molybdenum tracking upwards.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March. A lot of volatility in metals before that. So some key materials that we use are based on metals, so zinc and molybdenum and stuff like that. All of them had been tracking up.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability faces current challenges due to rising costs, despite a positive revenue outlook.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive. However, on the earnings, profitability is a little bit of a challenge right now.

margins_costs.claim: The construction chemicals segment operates at a profit before tax margin of about 20%.
margins_costs.quote: I'll just add that in this segment, we are operating at a PBT of about 20 odd percent which is the, I mean, I've not known any of our peers in the industry operating at those levels.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is starting the financial year with a strong order book for its chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

capital_allocation.claim: Days sales outstanding for construction chemicals stood at around 88 days as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company intends to deploy part of its funds toward network growth and geographical expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share for FY 2025-26, amounting to ₹336.20 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 (Rupee One and Paise Twenty-Five only) per equity share of ₹5 (Rupees Five only) each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Post-war declaration resulted in a challenging raw material period, prompting the company to invoke force majeure quickly.
risks_headwinds.quote: And post-war declaration, it was a very challenging period.

risks_headwinds.claim: Public sector units, which represent about 30% of the water business, did not accept force majeure declarations until the government declared it.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

management_commitments.claim: Management foresees around 15 to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in quarter one of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

management_commitments.claim: Management holds an aspirational target of reaching 1,000 crores as a company within four years.
management_commitments.quote: 1000 crore is, yes, it is an aspiratory number. We are trying to ensure that we have plans in place to get to that number.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
